<thought>From the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 211.076 ([M+H]⁺). Subtracting a proton (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈210.069 Da. The isotopic pattern shows a prominent M+2 peak (~33 % of the base), which is characteristic of a single chlorine atom (⁷⁵Cl/⁷⁷Cl natural abundance 3:1). Removing the chlorine mass (≈34.969 Da) leaves ~175.10 Da to be accounted for by C, H, and O. Searching for integer combinations that match the exact mass within a few ppm yields C₁₀H₇O₃Cl (exact monoisotopic mass 210.069 Da), which fits the observed isotopic distribution (≈10 carbons give the observed M+1 intensity). Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C10H7O3Cl.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H7O3Cl</final_answer>
